title: Payment-token pot is payable on a value-blind count-only gate (story-029 deleted the _snapshotRewards payment-token skip)
severityNote: Medium at 5015f1b; CONDITIONAL-HIGH TRIGGER ATTACHED: re-rate to High on deployment behind a value-forwarding dispatcher with the payment token whitelisted AND dispatcherIndex resolving to the prime token. Medium today only because the ledger records zero present on-chain exposure (pot 0 USDC, NudgeRatchet.batchMinter() repointed). Sigma/C = 4.00x at the project's own fixture; PoC shows +150.000000 USDC atomic on a 200.000000 pot vs 50.000000 cost, 5 NFTs.
note:
[phoenix-nft-staking-25] NEW MEDIUM @5015f1b (DEDUP-25-01). Story-029 DELETED the runtime `if (rewardToken == paymentToken) continue;` from _snapshotRewards, so the derived primeToken() now enters the pot set, is snapshotted pre-pull, floor-checked, and paid in full at :790 to a caller-chosen recipient on the UNCHANGED count-only gate at :507-511 (`qualifies = _nudgeSize != 0 && count >= _nudgeSize`). The gate was not touched; story-029 widened WHAT THE GATE CAN RELEASE. Witnesses: the repo's own passing test test_PaymentTokenAsNudge_qualifyingBatchStillEarnsThePot (:354-368, asserts pot == 200_000000 paid to nftRecipient) and Tier-3 INV-25-01 invariant_NoAtomicProfitFromQualifyingBatch FAILED first run (128,000-call budget, zero handler reverts, mutation-controlled). Break-even pot P > C + gas ~= 71.60 => 8 ratchet mints at fixture price, 6 at the mainnet-observed price = 70.000000.

*** RE-FILE DISCLOSURE (disclose-when-refiling-owner-wontfix) - THIS ENTRY DOES NOT OVERRIDE ANY WONT-FIX. *** Prior entries NAMED: 43e8c48626ee74b51d538bd9ed12bf4898b976818f6fb44fea844ff3757daefe (M-01, wont-fix) and 858e9e807abee888b378db210bae982f23fe7b5d91052321e204d7ba568579b7 (H-01, wont-fix). Quoted rationales: 43e8c486 - 'Safe config remains: keep Sigma(pot_i) < nudgeSize*mintPrice ... RE-ARM trigger unchanged: re-rate the moment a live/pending deployment funds the whitelist so Sigma(pot_i) approaches/exceeds one qualifying cost.'; 858e9e80 - 'THE 6.7x MARGIN IS REAL', RE-RATE triggers (b) 'nudge pot ... exceeding nudgeSize x 70.000000 USDC' and (e) 'deployment of src/BatchNFTMinterMultiToken.sol behind any value-forwarding dispatcher.' RE-FILE BASIS: both Sigma figures were computed over a pot set that STRUCTURALLY EXCLUDED the payment token, because at triage time _snapshotRewards skipped it at runtime. Story-029 deleted that skip and ADDED A POOL TO Sigma, so the prior arithmetic is not a statement about 5015f1b. Root-cause class changed (_snapshotRewards scope, not the gate) => new fingerprint. Both prior wont-fixes STAND UNTOUCHED - their own re-arm triggers (b) and (e) are MET, not bypassed (NudgeRatchet IS a value-forwarding dispatcher). This entry supplies only the delta.

KI #15 does NOT suppress this: excluded by KI #15's own carve-out (d), 'the aggregate over-funding class ... which is about the pot being too LARGE relative to cost'. This finding does NOT assert 'batching is profitable', 'the pot is sniped by MEV bots', 'payment token should not be whitelisted as a nudge token', or 'setNudgeTokenWhitelist no longer rejects the payment token' - none of those may be reintroduced into the writeup. Law 3 does not suppress either: docs/multi-token-nudge.md §4.1 AFFIRMATIVELY BLESSES the collision configuration as 'permitted and safe, not forbidden', so an owner following the project's own documentation is not making an admin mistake. Story-faithfulness F-25-01: the implementation is FAITHFUL to commit 0318089 §3.2; the defect is in the STORY'S OWN JUSTIFICATION (Law 1 over Law 2 - an unsafe intent is escalated, not blessed). REMEDY (single shared fix with M-02/L-02): cap the total nudge payout against the payment actually charged this batch (`paymentAmount - refund`, already computed at :664), or make the gate a value gate.
